goal: The VM runs R0-baseline, confirmed by SHA, and the same commit is recorded as VM-baseline.
why: User 10-07 00:5x KST: do not wait passively for the 30-minute update cycle; confirm the code the VM actually runs, so VMAUTO and VMHUB are judged on the same baseline.
acceptance: a VM message names the ga-sdk SHA it runs, and it equals R0-baseline (no longer 0.18.1 / f9671da)
the R0 tests run on the VM at that SHA and the result is stored as evidence in a repository
VM-baseline = R0-baseline is recorded where later measurements cite it; every later measurement row names the SHA it ran on
a mismatch or a VM silence longer than 2 h after Dev's release is an incident/1
constraints: a step only the user can do on the VM is a status/1 blocker with the exact action and cause
no model runs continuously on the VM until the user sets the budget (ASK-VM-COST)
